replies.title: AI selects groups and replies to individual messages
replies.description: AI scans all community groups, finds unanswered messages among the latest messages and prioritizes groups with the most pending messages. Each message receives an individual reply from a group persona, quoting the original message. Bots do not combine multiple messages into one reply, and answered messages are not answered again. Admin does not need to select groups.
